interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the providers, the key, the models and the buttons.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through choosing a provider, fetching models and testing it.

interactive.label: Sign in via browser
interactive.tooltip: Open the provider's console to create or copy an API key.

interactive.label: base_url
interactive.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the selected provider.

interactive.label: api_key
interactive.tooltip: Bearer token for the endpoint, drawn as stars. Pasting a key (Enter, or a click elsewhere) auto-saves it and tests the connection. Not needed for most local servers.

interactive.label: Show key
interactive.tooltip: Show the API key in clear text instead of stars. For this session only: a provider switch hides it again, and the setting is never saved.

interactive.label: text_model
interactive.tooltip: Used for chat, code editing, explanations, and other text tasks. Type any model id, or pick one of the fetched models below.

interactive.label: image_model
interactive.tooltip: Used only for plugin icon and other image-generation tasks. Type any model id, or pick one of the fetched models below.

interactive.label: Fetch models
interactive.tooltip: Query the endpoint's /models list and split it into text and image models. Runs in the background.

interactive.label: Test connection
interactive.tooltip: Check the endpoint responds to a /models request. Runs in the background.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Persist the current provider's settings to ai_api_settings.json in the settings folder.

interactive.label: Reset
interactive.tooltip: Reset the current provider's fields to defaults (not saved until you press Save).
